description: Paid endpoint ($0.002): crypto news sentiment for one asset: -1..1 score, bearish/neutral/bullish label, pos/neg/neu headline counts and up to 5 top headlines with links. Headlines labeled by a local LLM, score is plain math, refreshed about every 15 min. Symbols not in the current snapshot or stale data return an error and no charge (free list: GET /sentiment). Returns the x402 payment requirements and URL. Free sample response: https://cryptofeed402.site/samples/sentiment
name: get_sentiment
title: News sentiment (paid, x402)
